tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Tools: cool grey. Member: warm sand.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, chat panel, table rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, neutral badges, skeletons, selected-nothing backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Presenter bar (tools) and site footer (member). Only ink-inverse text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on action fills.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between rows and sections. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Functional borders: inputs, checkboxes, secondary-button-free outlines, table frame. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: THE one interactive colour per look: primary fills, secondary-button borders and text, links, selected tab, focus ring. Never on non-interactive text or decoration.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of action fills and links.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, selected nav item and the member's own chat bubble. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring with a 2px surface-coloured gap. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: approved
tokens.usage: Approved and live. Always with the word "Approved" or a check icon. Text and icon colour on surface, surface-raised and approved-soft.

tokens.name: approved-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background behind approved text.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Waiting for a person: in review, waiting for Legal, needs a decision. Always with a word and a clock icon. Text and icon colour on surface, surface-raised and review-soft.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background behind review text.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked or error: conflict, send-back, failed action. Always with a word and an alert icon. Text and icon colour on surface, surface-raised and blocked-soft.

tokens.name: blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background behind blocked text.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Source changed or past review date. Always with a word and a refresh icon. Distinct from review so the two never read as one state. Text and icon colour on surface, surface-raised and stale-soft.

tokens.name: stale-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and banner background behind stale text.

tokens.name: diff-del-ink
tokens.usage: Removed words in a diff. Always with strikethrough, so colour is never the only cue.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind removed words.

tokens.name: diff-add-ink
tokens.usage: Added words in a diff. Always underlined, so colour is never the only cue.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind added words.

tokens.name: highlight-bg
tokens.usage: Source passage highlight behind the span a unit was extracted from. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a dialog. Not used behind the chat panel, which floats without a scrim.

families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Internal tools
groups.note: Studio, Legal review, agent desktop, insights, developer docs, presenter bar. Dense ratio, two weights (400 and 600). No sentence below 16px.

styles.name: tools-title
styles.usage: Item title in a detail pane, dialog title.

styles.name: tools-body
styles.sample: Prices vary by pharmacy and plan.
styles.usage: All running text, table cells, inputs.

styles.name: tools-label
styles.usage: Field labels, button labels, column headers.

styles.name: tools-meta
styles.sample: Version 2 · approved by Legal on Oct 12
styles.usage: Metadata in ink-muted. Same size as body; hierarchy comes from colour.

styles.name: tools-overline
styles.usage: Short uppercase group labels only (two to five words). The one exception to the 16px floor.

styles.name: tools-metric
styles.usage: Metric tile values, with tabular figures.

groups.name: Member site
groups.note: Harbor Health public website, mobile app and chat. Serif for headings only, sans for everything else. Larger ratio and generous line height.

styles.name: member-display
styles.sample: Know your drug costs before you go
styles.usage: One hero heading per page. 34px/42px under 640px wide.

styles.name: member-h3
styles.usage: Card headings and the chat panel title.

styles.name: member-body
styles.sample: Your price depends on your plan and the pharmacy you choose.
styles.usage: All running text and chat messages on the member site.

styles.name: member-body-lg
styles.sample: Find care, check costs and get answers in one place.

styles.name: member-meta
styles.sample: From Harbor Health drug pricing, updated Oct 12
styles.usage: Citations, timestamps and footer text, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Developer docs and unit IDs in internal tools.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, endpoints, unit IDs. Never on a member surface.

spacing.note: Base 16. Steps at least 25% apart. Tight inside related clusters, looser between sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field; between adjacent buttons (minimum).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside dense rows (table cells, queue items) and badge padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding in tools; between fields in a form; between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on the member site; between groups inside a pane.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page in tools.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on the member site.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Member hero padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Member page top and bottom padding at desktop width.

radius.note: Tools are slightly rounded and consistent. Member site is softer. Do not mix the two inside one surface.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tools: badges, inputs, checkboxes, diff marks, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tools: buttons, cards, panels, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tools: dialogs and the email client window.

tokens.name: radius-member
tokens.usage: Member: cards, inputs, buttons, chat panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Member: chat launcher, topic chips, chat bubbles' rounded ends. Never in tools.

shadow.note: Light from above. Two-part shadows tinted with ink, never pure black. Four elevations.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised: cards and panels on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating: popovers, dropdowns, toasts, sticky headers.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Overlay: dialogs and the member chat panel.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Device frames and the email client window in the guided demo.

size.note: Fixed layout sizes the surfaces share.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Default control height and touch target. Floors: 24px desktop, 44px mobile.

tokens.name: size-target-compact
tokens.usage: Dense tool controls (table toolbars, panel header search). Never on the member site.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar of every internal tool.

tokens.name: size-presenter
tokens.usage: Guided demo presenter bar.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail in Studio and insights.

tokens.name: size-queue
tokens.usage: Queue column in Studio My work and the Legal inbox.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Agent desktop knowledge panel.

tokens.name: size-chat
tokens.usage: Member chat panel width at desktop (full width under 640px).

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of running text.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of the member site.
